article.headline: Jonah Hinton scores 23 to lead Rhode Island to 79-64 victory over UAB at Greenbrier Tip-Off
article.description: — Jonah Hinton sank seven 3-pointers and scored 23 to lead Rhode Island to a 79-64 victory over UAB on Sunday at the Greenbrier Tip-Off.
article.linkText: Jonah Hinton scores 23 to lead Rhode Island to 79-64 victory over UAB at Greenbrier Tip-Off
article.story: WHITE SULPHUR SPRINGS, W.Va. -- — Jonah Hinton sank seven 3-pointers and scored 23 to lead Rhode Island to a 79-64 victory over UAB on Sunday at the Greenbrier Tip-Off. Hinton shot 7 for 10 from beyond the arc but missed both of his shots from inside it for the Rams (6-1). Dylan Williamson added 13 points and seven assists. Jahmere Tripp posted a double-double with 12 points and 11 rebounds. Deuce Jones scored 15 to lead the Blazers (4-3), who trailed 36-29 at halftime. Salim London and reserve KyeRon Lindsay-Martin both scored 12. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
